epic.name: Sleek CMS editor: overhaul the edit dialogs
epic.description:
The dialogs clients use to edit their sites are huge and padded: on a phone the "Edit: Teaching Item" dialog shows only three fields, under a giant heading, a big "Text" section title, centered labels and roomy boxes, with a long link cut off in a single-line box. Give them a complete overhaul: compact and sleek, so editing feels like a modern app.

Scope (all in packages/web-legos, used by every site): ModelEditModal (Modals.jsx), the text editor behind editable WLText/WLHeader, image upload behind WLImage, the Contact info dialog (SiteSettings.jsx) and Request changes (Auth.jsx).

  • Much less margin and padding; small left-aligned labels above fields; a short title (e.g. the item's name, not Edit: "Teaching Item").
  • Fields sized to their content: links wrap or scroll rather than truncating; descriptions grow with text.
  • Friendly field names, not model keys ("Link", "Order").
  • On phones a full-height sheet with Save/Cancel pinned at the bottom; on desktop a narrow dialog.
  • Delete as a quiet text action with a confirm step, not a big pink button at the top.
  • One look across all the dialogs, shown in the Storybook catalog.
